description:

Qualcomm Data Center Business Unit is seeking a passionate and highly motivated Software Engineer to join our AI Software team and help build the next generation of AI infrastructure for large-scale inference and fine-tuning workloads.
  
  
In this role, you will contribute to core platform technologies spanning host software, scalability infrastructure, and high-performance data movement solutions across Qualcomm's AI accelerator portfolio. You will design, develop, and optimize software that enables efficient execution of large language models (LLMs) while improving platform performance, scalability, reliability, and programmability.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong expertise in modern C++ development, object-oriented design, design patterns, Linux systems programming, distributed systems, and performance optimization. Experience with communication frameworks such as gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and low-level system software development is highly desirable.

* Build scalable infrastructure for distributed AI workloads, communication libraries, and data movement frameworks.
* Drive feature development, debugging, profiling, and performance optimization across the software stack.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including runtime, compiler, kernel, firmware, and hardware engineers.
* Participate in software architecture, design reviews, requirements definition, and implementation planning.

* Experience with unit testing frameworks and methodologies, including GoogleTest.
* Solid understanding of Linux systems programming, distributed systems, and large-scale software platforms.
* Experience with requirements management, traceability, and software lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with peripheral driver development, RDMA, and high-performance communication technologies.
* Understanding of system architecture, including CPU cores, cache hierarchies, memory subsystems, interconnects, buses, and I/O components.
* Experience using source code management and configuration management tools; strong Git knowledge is required.
* Experience with inter-process communication technologies such as gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
* Familiarity with software development and debugging tools.
* Ability to thrive in a structured software development environment while remaining hands-on with design, coding, testing, and debugging activities.

title: Senior Software Engineer C++ | Low Latency Trading Systems
description:
**About BestEx Research**
BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model.
  
  
Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U.S., Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading.
  
  
BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms.
  
  
BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients.
  
  
Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center." It's a core engineering and research hub, working on the exact same problems and projects as our U.S. team. You will be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science.
  
  
**What You'll Love:**

* Zero bureaucracy, zero silos—engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the management team
* Direct ownership of subsystems
* Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
* A high-trust environment, where performance speaks louder than hierarchy.
* Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
* Ability to transition between various teams and projects, whether related to trading systems, algorithmic trading or system tooling
* 5-week structured training program:
* Market microstructure and trading mechanics
* Algorithmic execution and strategy design
* Exchange simulators and performance testing
* Market data systems and real-time analytics
* Hands-on exercises using production research data
* Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
* Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U.S., Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

**Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch**
You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack—from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering—comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**
**Designing and developing system architecture**
:
  
  

* Core trading systems and algorithmic trading frameworks
* High-performance execution algorithms for global markets
* Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
* Market data adaptors and exchange connectivity adaptors

**Building from scratch**
:
  
  

* Trading systems for new asset classes and execution algorithms
* Performance optimizations for low-latency, high-throughput systems

**Enhancing existing systems**
:
  
  

* Add support for new features and improve scalability and reliability

**Collaborating closely with**
:
  
  

* A global team of quants, traders, and senior engineers to design cutting-edge solutions

**Analyzing and optimizing system performance**
:
  
  

* Across application, OS, and hardware layers to achieve industry-leading performance
* Work primarily with C++17 in a high-impact, low-bureaucracy environment

**Requirements**
**You Should Have:**

* Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
* At least 5+ years software development experience with C++
* Expert-level knowledge of C++ and excellent software design skills
* Expert-level knowledge of TCP/IP and multithreading
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
* Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate ideas
* An attitude of constant curiosity and growth, as well as the ability and desire to mentor others
* While domain experience is a plus, we welcome strong engineers from other industries

**Bonus Points For**

* Database optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
* Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
* Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools, ability to work with large datasets
* Prior experience developing trading systems or execution algorithms
* Knowledge of relational databases, database optimizations, and SQL
* Experience with Python/R

**Job Description For Firmware Engineer**

* Lead the design and implementation of multi-threaded firmware architectures using FreeRTOS on ARM Cortex-M or similar MCUs.
* Develop and optimize low-level drivers for I2C, SPI, UART, and CAN protocols from scratch.
* Manage RTOS primitives including Semaphores, Mutexes, Queues, and Event Groups for thread-safe operation.
* Configure and tune the FreeRTOS scheduler, task priorities, and memory management schemes (Heap\\_1 to Heap\\_5).
* Design high-performance Interrupt Service Routines (ISRs) and implement deferred processing using task notifications.
* Implement DMA-based data transfers to offload communication overhead from the CPU.
* Conduct board bring-up and debug hardware-software interface issues using Logic Analyzers and Oscilloscopes.
* Perform stack depth analysis and memory leak detection to ensure long-term system stability.
* Implement low-power modes and tickless idle configurations within the FreeRTOS framework.
* Ensure code compliance with MISRA C standards and lead rigorous peer code reviews.
* Define and document Hardware Abstraction Layers (HAL) and API specifications for modular firmware.
* Resolve complex concurrency issues such as race conditions, deadlocks, and priority inversion.
* Optimize bootloader performance and implement secure firmware-over-the-air (FOTA) update mechanisms.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to validate schematics and define pin multiplexing requirements.
* Manage version control workflows using Git and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Mentor junior engineers on real-time systems programming and protocol debugging techniques.
* Analyze worst-case execution time (WCET) to guarantee real-time response for critical system tasks.
* Manage third-party library integration and middleware stacks (TCP/IP, USB, or File Systems).
* Drive root-cause analysis for intermittent field failures related to timing or protocol violations.
* Provide technical estimates and roadmap planning for firmware delivery milestones.

title: Lead Research Engineer - LLM Optimization & Agentic Systems
description:
**Company:**
CraftifAI

**Work arrangement:**
Full-time, work from office

**Role focus:**
70% hands-on research and engineering; 30% technical leadership and ownership

**Preferred joining timeline:**
Candidates who can join in fewer than 45 days are preferred.

About CraftifAI

CraftifAI is building
**Orbit**
, a platform that automates engineering workflows across embedded software, Edge AI, and FPGA development. Our work connects requirements, domain knowledge, code generation, testing, validation, and deployment to help engineering teams build working products.

We are looking for a research-driven engineer who can strengthen the LLMs and agentic systems behind these workflows, with a particular focus on efficient on-premises deployment and reliable code generation.

About the Role

You will lead the research and implementation of domain-specific LLM solutions and agentic systems for engineering applications. This includes fine-tuning models, reducing their deployment footprint while preserving measured task quality, designing knowledge architectures, building agent harnesses, and establishing rigorous product benchmarks.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
. Approximately 70% of your time will involve coding, experiments, model optimization, evaluation, and product integration. The remaining 30% will involve architecture decisions, research direction, mentoring, and ownership of technical outcomes.

You should be comfortable moving from a research hypothesis to an implementation, measuring its impact, understanding its failures, and improving it until it works reliably within the product.

What You Will Own

1. LLM Fine-Tuning and Efficient On-Premises Deployment

* Adapt LLMs for engineering tasks, including code generation, tool use, debugging, and reasoning over domain-specific information.
* Build data preparation and fine-tuning workflows using suitable approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference optimization.
* Apply and evaluate compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to reduce model size and memory requirements.
* Measure trade-offs between task quality, model footprint, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost on target deployment hardware.

2. Agentic Systems for Code Generation

* Design and implement agent harnesses for task planning, repository exploration, context management, code generation, tool execution, debugging, and iterative correction.
* Build reliable execution flows with clear state management, failure recovery, stopping conditions, and observable results.
* Improve the ability of agents to complete engineering tasks across multiple files, dependencies, tools, and execution environments.
* Own the integration of these capabilities into CraftifAI’s product workflows.

3. Domain Knowledge and Context Architecture

* Design knowledge systems that connect source code, requirements, architecture documents, hardware documentation, SDKs, APIs, and previous engineering outcomes.
* Develop effective retrieval and context construction using approaches such as hybrid search, reranking, structured knowledge, and repository-aware retrieval.
* Decide when information belongs in model training, retrieval, structured tools, or persistent agent memory.
* Keep retrieved information traceable to its source, version, and applicable hardware or software configuration.

4. Code Quality and Automated Verification

* Build and integrate static analysis tools, compiler diagnostics, linters, code structure checks, and security checks into agent workflows.
* Combine these checks with automated builds, unit tests, and controlled execution to evaluate generated code.
* Convert tool findings into actionable feedback that agents can use to diagnose and correct their outputs.
* Establish quality gates and regression checks that provide objective evidence of improvement.

5. Low-Latency System Design

* Profile and optimize the complete workflow, including retrieval, context preparation, model inference, tool calls, and correction cycles.
* Improve serving, caching, batching, context efficiency, and execution routing where they produce measurable benefits.
* Design for practical on-premises constraints, including available compute, GPU memory, concurrency, and restricted external connectivity.
* Optimize time to a verified result alongside model response time.

6. Reasoning and Learning from Field Use

* Improve agent planning, tool selection, debugging, and recovery through systematic failure analysis and controlled experiments.
* Turn field failures and user feedback into curated datasets, evaluation cases, improved knowledge, and better agent behavior.
* Evaluate suitable methods for improving reasoning and tool use, including fine-tuning, preference learning, and reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Validate improvements against regression benchmarks before release, within customer data and deployment constraints.

7. Product Benchmarking and Technical Leadership

* Own reproducible benchmarks at both model and complete product workflow levels.
* Measure task completion, functional correctness, static analysis findings, test results, human intervention, latency, memory use, and compute cost.
* Use held-out tasks, baseline comparisons, ablation studies, and error analysis to explain which changes improve the product and why.
* Define research priorities, lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and take ownership from experimentation through product integration.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* **Minimum qualification: MS by Research from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad**
  , in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field.
  **A PhD is preferred.**
* Strong practical experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them on private or on-premises infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience reducing model size or inference memory requirements, supported by measured quality and performance results.
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic systems for code generation, including tool integration, execution feedback, and iterative repair.
* Strong understanding of domain knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, context management, and their interaction with model behavior.
* Strong Python and software engineering skills, with practical experience using frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, PEFT, or equivalent tools.
* Experience integrating static analysis, build systems, automated testing, or other programmatic checks into code-generation workflows.
* Strong research discipline: clear hypotheses, controlled experiments, reproducible results, and careful interpretation of failures.
* Ability to make architecture decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and personally implement critical parts of the solution.

Additional Experience We Value

* Research publications or open-source contributions in efficient LLMs, code models, reasoning, agentic systems, or program analysis.
* Experience with C/C++, embedded software, compilers, firmware, or hardware-aware code generation.
* Experience with model serving, inference profiling, distributed training, or resource-constrained deployments.
* Experience turning research prototypes into maintained production capabilities.

**The Role**
As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production.

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams.

* Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug.

* Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements.
* Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations.

* Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations.

* Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures.
* Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149.x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features.
* Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives.
* Experience applying AI and data-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization.
* Ability to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks.
